xeno.options.title: Xeno Settings
xeno.options.restart_required: Game restart required to apply graphics backend changes.
xeno.options.graphics_api.desc: Chooses the preferred graphics rendering API. Default relies on native platforms; Vulkan offers modern hardware optimizations.
xeno.options.gui_scale.desc: Adjusts the size of the user interface.
xeno.options.render_distance.desc: Determines how far chunks are rendered around the player. Higher values increase visibility but cost more performance.
xeno.options.simulation_distance.desc: Controls how far entity simulations and block ticks occur. Lower values reduce CPU load.
xeno.options.fps_limit.desc: Caps the maximum frames per second. Lower values reduce GPU load and power consumption.
xeno.options.vsync.desc: Synchronizes frame output with monitor refresh rate. Reduces screen tearing but may add input lag.
xeno.options.fullscreen.desc: Toggles between windowed and fullscreen display modes.
xeno.options.exclusive_fullscreen.desc: Enables exclusive control over the monitor display when running in fullscreen.
xeno.options.attack_indicator.desc: Sets the display style and position for the combat crosshair attack indicator.
xeno.options.autosave_indicator.desc: Enables a subtle disk indicator in the corner of the screen when the game performs an autosave.
xeno.options.graphics_preset.desc: Controls visual graphics preset. Fast disables extra lighting effects; Fabulous enables advanced layers.
xeno.options.ambient_occlusion.desc: Applies ambient shadows between blocks to present smooth, atmospheric surface illumination.
xeno.options.clouds.desc: Adjusts cloud styling. Fancy renders volumetric clouds; OFF disables cloud layers completely.
xeno.options.cloud_distance.desc: Specifies the maximum distance (in chunks) cloud models are rendered.
xeno.options.biome_blend.desc: Determines blending radius for neighboring biome colors. OFF yields sharp boundaries; higher values blend smoothly.
xeno.options.particles.desc: Specifies density of environmental, combat, and command-driven particles.
xeno.options.mipmap.desc: Sharpens distant textures using multi-resolution texture maps. Lower levels can improve performance.
xeno.options.entity_shadows.desc: Enables circular shadow silhouettes beneath living entity entities and items.
xeno.options.cutout_leaves.desc: Controls leaf block transparency. Solid opaque leaves bypass translucency checks and render faster.
xeno.options.weather_radius.desc: Defines block radius for weather rendering and audio sources centered on the player.
xeno.options.vignette.desc: Applies a cinematic darkening overlay around the borders of the screen.
xeno.options.chunk_fade_time.desc: Applies smooth fade-in animations to newly loaded chunk sections.
xeno.options.entity_distance.desc: Adjusts the distance threshold for rendering entity models. Lower scaling values save significant GPU time.
xeno.options.texture_filtering.desc: Applies texture sampling methods. RGSS or Anisotropic filtering keep oblique angles sharp.
xeno.options.anisotropic_value.desc: Specifies level of anisotropic filtering. Higher values retain fine textures on steep slopes.
